note: Maps articles to a photo search query. At build time, fetch-photos.mjs turns each query into a real, licence-clean photo (Pexels/Pixabay/Unsplash) IF an API key is present in the environment. On Vercel, add PEXELS_API_KEY (or the others) as an Environment Variable and every listed article gets a real South African photo automatically, with its credit. With no key, or offline, the article keeps its generated cover art. Data pieces (charts) and Winners profiles are deliberately absent: charts stay as SVG, and Winners must use the person's own or official photo, never a stock face.
